items.title: 2.9 Do dimensions mein elastic takrao (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.9 with Fig. 2.15 and Example 2.9 (PDF 44-45, 49-50; printed 41-42, 46-47).

blocks.text: Jab ek axis ke saath chalte do jism takrao ke baad usi pehli axis par nahi chalte, to yeh do-dimensional takrao hai. Agar takrao elastic ho to jismon ka system apna kul linear momentum aur kul kinetic energy dono barqarar (conserved) rakhta hai.

Do jism lein jo ek tirchhe (glancing) angle par elastic takrao karte hain, yani seedhi (head-on) takkar nahi. Pehle jism (projectile) ka mass m₁ hai aur initial velocity v⃗₁i; doosre jism (target) ka mass m₂ hai aur woh shuru mein ruka hua hai, v⃗₂i = 0. Takrao par dono ke darmiyan impulses paida hote hain jo unhen x-axis (jis par projectile pehle chal raha tha) se θ₁ aur θ₂ angles par bhej dete hain (Fig. 2.15).

blocks.alt: x aur y axes; gend m2 origin par ruki hui hai. Gend m1 x axis ke saath velocity v1i se aati hai. Takrao ke baad m1 axis se oopar zaviye theta1 par v1f se, aur m2 axis se neeche zaviye theta2 par v2f se chali jati hai.
blocks.caption: Do simton mein elastic tirchha (glancing) takrao (Figure 2.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Yani glancing collision woh elastic takrao hai jo do jismon ke darmiyan seedha (head-on) na ho.
Shuru mein mass m₂ wala jism (target) ruka hua hai.

Takrao se pehle projectile ka momentum m₁v⃗₁i hai aur target ka momentum zero. Takrao ke baad projectile (mass m₁, velocity v⃗₁f) ka momentum m₁v⃗₁f hai aur target (mass m₂, velocity v⃗₂f) ka m₂v⃗₂f. Projectile ke final momentum ke components m₁v⃗₁f cos θ₁ aur m₁v⃗₁f sin θ₁ hain; isi tarah target ke components m₂v⃗₂f cos θ₂ aur m₂v⃗₂f sin θ₂.

blocks.text_alt: Momentum before collision = Momentum after collision
m₁v₁i = m₁v₁f cos θ₁ + m₂v₂f cos θ₂
m₁v₁i - m₁v₁f cos θ₁ = m₂v₂f cos θ₂   (2.34)

blocks.text: y-axis ke saath momentum conservation (shuru mein y-momentum zero tha; ek jism oopar aur doosra neeche jata hai, is liye minus):

blocks.text_alt: Momentum before collision = Momentum after collision
0 = m₁v₁f sin θ₁ - m₂v₂f sin θ₂
m₁v₁f sin θ₁ = m₂v₂f sin θ₂   (2.35)

blocks.text: Elastic takrao mein kinetic energy bhi barqarar rehti hai; ½ dono taraf se kat jata hai:

In equations mein chaar na-maloom quantities hain: v⃗₁f, v⃗₂f, θ₁ aur θ₂. Agar inhen naap liya jaye to equations (2.34), (2.35) aur (2.36) se momentum aur energy ka conservation sabit kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Inelastic takrao mein kinetic energy ka kuch hissa garmi, awaz aur shakal bigarne (deformation) mein chala jata hai. Misal: lakri ke block mein goli maari jaye to takrao inelastic hai, kyun ke goli ki kuch energy awaz aur garmi ban jati hai. Isi tarah kisi unchai se farsh par giri gend usi unchai tak wapas nahi uchhalti, kyun ke us ki kuch kinetic energy awaz aur garmi ban jati hai.

blocks.title: Example 2.9
blocks.problem: 1 kg mass ka zarra 'A' 5 m s⁻¹ ki initial velocity se daen taraf chal kar usi mass ke ruke hue target 'B' se takrata hai. Takrao ke baad 'A' horizontal se 30° oopar 3 m s⁻¹ ki speed se aur 'B' horizontal se 53° par 4 m s⁻¹ ki speed se chalta hai. Sabit karein ke takrao elastic hai. (Kitab mein yeh example topic 2.12 ke baad chhapa hai.)
steps: Pehle ka momentum: m₁v₁i + m₂v₂i = (1 kg × 5 m s⁻¹) + (1 kg × 0) = 5 kg m s⁻¹
Baad ka x-momentum: (1 kg × 3 m s⁻¹ × cos 30°) + (1 kg × 4 m s⁻¹ × cos 53°) = 2.60 + 2.40 = 5 kg m s⁻¹; x-simt mein momentum barqarar hai.
Pehle ki K.E.: ½ × 1 × (5)² + ½ × 1 × 0 = 12.5 J
blocks.answer: Momentum (x-simt mein) aur K.E. dono barqarar hain, is liye takrao elastic hai.

blocks.caption: Tirchhe elastic takrao ki teen equations
rows: m₁v₁i = m₁v₁f cos θ₁ + m₂v₂f cos θ₂
m₁v₁f sin θ₁ = m₂v₂f sin θ₂

blocks.prompt: Example 2.9 mein y-axis ke saath bhi momentum check karein. Yeh bhi batayein ke kinetic energy ko components mein torne ki zaroorat kyun nahi pari.
blocks.explanation: Baad ka y-momentum: 1 × 3 × sin 30° - 1 × 4 × sin 53° = 1.50 - 3.19 = -1.7 kg m s⁻¹, jo zero nahi. Yani kitab ke diye angles ke saath y-momentum barabar nahi hota; kitab ka hal sirf x-momentum aur energy check karta hai. (Barabar mass ke elastic takrao mein dono raste aapas mein 90° par hote hain; 3 m s⁻¹ aur 4 m s⁻¹ ki speeds ke liye angles taqreeban 53° aur 37° bante.) Kinetic energy scalar hai, is liye ½mv² mein seedhi speed lagti hai, components ki zaroorat nahi.

items: Tirchha elastic takrao, target ruka hua: x-momentum m₁v₁i = m₁v₁f cos θ₁ + m₂v₂f cos θ₂; y-momentum m₁v₁f sin θ₁ = m₂v₂f sin θ₂; energy m₁v₁i² = m₁v₁f² + m₂v₂f²; chaar na-maloom: v₁f, v₂f, θ₁, θ₂.
